text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two armed people attack a guard at the Russian Consulate, Interior Ministry continues probe in the incident.
- Bahrain-based Gulf University to host a regional meeting for environmental experts in September.
- Egyptian embassy official briefs Bahrain's Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Mubarak al-Khalifa about November's economic conference in Cairo.
- Pension fund paid 210,000 dinars in six months to relatives of government employees who have died.
